answer: Harbor quarantine resists Sybil attacks: every new identity docks first in a supervised harbor, where it trades only with vetted sponsors and each deal is inspected before settlement. Trust grows like a vine, one verified job at a time, branching only along routes the agent has actually served. A fake stays penned in the harbor until it completes real, inspected work, and umber-marked records bar any identity caught cheating from graduation. One honest agent clears quarantine fast; a thousand fakes need a thousand inspected histories, turning cheap cloning into slow, expensive labor.
